verdict.rationale: Scheduling automation is a fair question for a release-management platform, so the axis applies. However, the only scheduling evidence is one-off scheduled flag changes 'for future points in time', and nothing documents recurring jobs or workflows. A one-off future action is not a recurring schedule, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Scheduling flag changes lets you define and schedule changes to your flag's targeting rules for future points in time.
